newsitem.title: POLAND: NKT Cables in second Kable call.
newsitem.headline: NKT Cables in second Kable call.

text.p: Denmark's NKT Cables announced a public tender offer for 500,000 shares in Polish cable maker Kable SA at 27.9 zlotys per share, the agent of the tender said in a newspaper announcement on Thursday.
On Wednesday NKT Cables, which currently has 25 percent in Kable, announced a tender for one million shares at the same price and said it would call another tender for 500,000 shares.
ING Barring Securities said in the statement NKT Cables wanted to gain a 100-percent control in Kable.
Kable has two million shares oustanding.
Kable's current shareholders will be able to subscribe to sell the shares from February 27 to March 28, the statement said.
The bourse suspended trade in Kable on Thursday, following the tender announcement.
Kable closed at 39.9 zlotys on Wednesday.
